title: For Authors | MMWR
content: For Authors Print Minus Related Pages Thank you for your interest in submitting a report to MMWR . Following the steps below will result in a smoother process for all. 1. Consult the Instructions Before submitting a report, authors should carefully read and follow the instructions for writing an MMWR Weekly or Serial Publications (i.e. Recommendations and Reports, Surveillance Summary, and Supplements). Reports submitted to MMWR that do not follow these instructions will be returned to the authors for rewrite and resubmission. Weekly Publications Instructions Serial Publications Instructions 2. Use the Checklist Before submitting your report, complete the appropriate checklist to ensure you have met all the criteria. The checklist will be included with your submission. Weekly Publications Checklist [PDF - 133 KB] Serial Publications Checklist [PDF - 217 KB] 3. Submit your Manuscript MMWR uses ScholarOne Manuscripts for submission and tracking (manuscripts submitted via email will be returned). After submitting you will receive an email with your manuscript number. Please refer to the manuscript number in all further correspondence. Weekly Publications ScholarOne External Link Icon Serial Publications ScholarOne External Link Icon If you have any questions, please contact MMWRq@cdc.gov .
